# Muse voice rolls out


By OpenTools Team


·


November 6, 2026


The US feature rollout is narrower than Muse’s app availability.


##


App geography is a different clock


Muse’s availability in a country does not establish access to every new feature. Meta’s[Singapore launch](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/10/muse-is-now-available-in-singapore-the-worlds-first-personal-ai-agent-built-for-everyone/) made the app available there on iOS, Android and the web. Its local connector features were also described as arriving progressively.


The same app‑versus‑feature distinction matters for voice. The new announcement starts in the US; the[Singapore app launch](https://opentools.ai/news/meta-muse-singapore-eight-partners-phased-connectors) does not establish access to this rollout.


##


Voice and avatars


Meta’s[voice announcement](https://about.fb.com/news/2026/11/introducing-muse-ai-voice-expressive-avatars/) says voice and avatars are rolling out on mobile, web and Mac, starting in the US. Tap the top‑right phone icon. Choose voice alone, an avatar beside the conversation, or full screen.


Voice on AI Glasses and Muse Charm is still coming soon. No international voice date is supplied.


Mark Zuckerberg F8 2019 Keynote, April 30, 2019; archive Meta‑company context, not Muse’s voice interface or launch.
